t: The Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Shank Mixed Impact Bit Set provides a complete drilling and fastening solution for heavy-duty applications. This robust impact bit set is ideal for professional tradespeople undertaking demanding site work. Laser-hardened Wearguardtip technology improves wear resistance and maintains a precise fit over the bit's life. Optimised Shockzone geometry is engineered to flex, reducing stress at the tip and minimising breakages by absorbing impacts. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these bits offer increased resistance to shock from high-torque impact driving.
